title: Flummox!
description: Flummox!, a Teletext quiz in the style of Bamboozle!. Felix Flummox asks 12 questions; press the coloured button for your answer. Can you flummox Felix?
label: FLUMMOX

rows.alt: Felix Flummox, the quizmaster: a grinning cartoon with a green quiff, round glasses, a red bow tie and a blue jacket.
beside: {yellow}Felix Flummox{/}, your quizmaster, has 12 questions for you.
Press the coloured button for your answer. Get one wrong and you're {yellow}FLUMMOXED!{/}

rows: Flummox! needs JavaScript to play. The quiz is in the style of Channel 4's Teletext classic, Bamboozle!.
